# KDocs-Pro

KDocs-Pro is a Kenyan web app that generates professional documents from
simple forms: CVs/resumes, cover letters, job application letters, leave
requests, salary increment requests, offer acceptance letters, resignation
letters, reference requests, farewell letters, handover reports, experience
certificates, recommendation letters, self-appraisals, admission letters,
school leave letters, fee waiver/bursary requests, freelance invoices,
meeting minutes, and business cards.

## How it works

- Users pick a document, choose a visual template, and fill in their details.
- A free watermarked PDF preview is generated instantly, with the "Ready
  Score" panel: a structural checklist, improvement suggestions, and (for CVs)
  keyword matching against a pasted job advert. Rule-based - it never invents
  personal information.
- A clean, watermark-free PDF download costs KSh 20 or KSh 50 depending on
  the document (job-hunting suites and admission letters are KSh 50; most
  other documents stay KSh 20), paid via IntaSend (M-Pesa, card, or bank
  transfer). Payment is confirmed server-side before the clean PDF is ever
  produced.
- Accounts are optional; signed-in users get a Document Locker to re-download
  past purchases free.

## Key facts

- Market: Kenya (pricing in Kenyan Shillings)
- Support: kdocspro@gmail.com
- Policies: /terms.html, /privacy.html, /refund.html
- Documents are generated from user-provided content; KDocs-Pro is a tool,
  not a professional advisory service.
